purpose: Final evaluation plan for the one-time Test/Holdout phase.

primary_endpoint.aggregation: per-L mean over 10 seeds (42..51); then average_MSE_4L = arithmetic mean over L in {24,36,48,60}

key_secondary.rule: reported; never combined with MSE into an invented score

additional_endpoints: PTE/PIE + hit rates (peak-evaluation-v1 spec, secondary public-health)
horizon_weighting: equal (arithmetic mean over L); matches Wave-1

seed_handling.policy: each frozen per-seed checkpoint is restored and evaluated on Test; report per-seed and seed-mean per L; no seed selection

confidence_interval_method: standard error across 10 seeds per L; t-distribution 95% CI (df=9)
paired_unpaired: matched-seed paired comparisons (candidate vs each comparator), paired t-test on the 10 seeds per L
multiple_comparison: Holm-Bonferroni across the pre-registered confirmatory tests
missing_data_policy: Test windows complete by construction; any missing window => fail-stop (no imputation)
outlier_policy: no outlier removal; all Test target windows included
tie_equivalence_policy: report both; never manufacture a unique winner

validation_to_test_gap.definition: Test average_MSE_4L - Validation average_MSE_4L (also per-L); negative = better on Test

success_interpretation: descriptive generalization report; no pre-registered pass/fail threshold
